enum.name: sent
enum.description: email notification with a link has been sent to at least one recipient, and it stays in this state until recipients have at least viewed it

enum.name: delivered
enum.description: all recipients have viewed the documents in the signing experience

enum.name: declined
enum.description: a recipient has explicitly declined to sign; signing will never be completed

enum.name: voided
enum.description: the sender has voided the DUC or it has expired

enum.name: correct
enum.description: the sender has opened the envelope for correction; the signing process is paused
